summary: Completed regression testing for restored administrator dashboard and student navigation. Public API suite passed 5/5; browser workflow passed role switching, dashboard sections, user status, certificate/event/mission creation, report refresh, and student missions navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: The existing pytest module requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in the shell environment; the test command must load frontend/.env before execution.
seed_data_creation: Browser test created QA Certificate, QA Admin Event, and QA Mission records in the demo database; these are non-destructive test records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin overview and all tested admin mutations passed. Student missions navigation remained functional. Catalog campus, admin community member detail, and full student chat/profile flows were not exercised in this iteration.
rca of the issue: Initial pytest invocation failed during collection because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was not exported by the shell (5 collection errors). Rerunning after loading frontend/.env passed all five tests; this is test-environment setup, not an application failure.
